_comment: Copy to config.json (git-ignored) and run: flutter run --dart-define-from-file=config.json. Every key is a compile-time constant; change one and rebuild. The values here are the built-in defaults, azuma's demo tenant: a bare flutter run uses exactly them, and a test keeps this file and the code equal. Blank every Health-ID key to disable that flow. The Health-ID values point at the Mimoto reference environment; the client id is public, the relying-party id and redirect URI come from that client registration.
_transfer: Variant A, account transfer from a previous identity provider. Empty here, so the flow stays disabled and says so. DOA validates google and apple tokens only, so TRANSFER_DOA_PROVIDER names the route that accepts this provider's id token, and its client id must be in that tenant's ValidAudiences. The redirect must be claimed by the app: Android through the App Link filter built from transferCallbackHost/Path in android/gradle.properties, iOS through the associated domain and its apple-app-site-association.
_transfer_demo: true shows the transfer screens without any provider: an in-app sheet stands in for the sign-in and accepts anything, and the journey ends before DOA with a notice, because DOA would refuse a token minted here. Debuggable builds only; a release build ignores it entirely.
